race.comment: In a modest maiden KING KORUNA (10) brings superior form to the table. Raced on the pace and tried hard but was swamped late and finished a very close fifth over 1200m at Swan Hill last start. Like him coming back to 1100m. Draws a perfect gate and on what we have seen recently he should be a too strong for these. WANTED ENUFF (14) is back for a second prep following a 27-week spell. Best of three runs to date was a placing on debut over this distance at Kyneton. In the mix with a repeat of that effort. GRACEFUL MIST (11) wasn't far away over 1200m at Mornington most recently. Yet to score in 24 tries so hard to get too enthusiastic. Recent trial winner DON'T SAY NO MIKKI (4) might need more ground but is not out of contention fresh from an 11-week break. CALM THE PRESS (3) has placed at two of four runs over today's trip and has drawn to advantage.
